courses.title: 化學機械平坦化
courses.summary: 從移除量與平坦度、碟陷與侵蝕到整合驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Removal versus planarity and Dishing and erosion to Integration acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 移除量與平坦度 → 晶圓徑向控制
stages.titleEn: Removal versus planarity to Radial wafer control
stages.description: 把「移除量與平坦度」「Preston 近似」「晶圓徑向控制」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Removal versus planarity, Preston approximation, Radial wafer control.

steps.title: 移除量與平坦度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.
steps.instruction:
畫三點研磨前後高度並分算移除量和剩餘高差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一高度基準下三個配對測點研磨前為 110、100、90 nm，研磨後為 75、70、65 nm。逐點移除量為 35、30、25 nm，平均 30 nm；表面高度極差由 20 降為 10 nm。請分別畫高度與移除量，不把平均移除量當成平坦度；三點不足以代表整片晶圓。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw before/after heights at three sites and calculate removal separately from residual height difference. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume three matched sites share one height datum: before polishing 110, 100 and 90 nm; after 75, 70 and 65 nm. Removal is 35, 30 and 25 nm, averaging 30 nm; surface-height range falls from 20 to 10 nm. Plot height and removal separately. Mean removal is not flatness, and three sites do not characterize a wafer.
steps.observation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
steps.observationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「移除量與平坦度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化。
算例驗收：驗算平均移除 30 nm、殘餘高度極差 10 nm，並標出配對測點與共同基準。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Removal versus planarity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 30 nm mean removal and 10 nm residual height range; identify matched sites and the common datum.

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Physics and model

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」。
假設數值與推算：假設同一高度基準下三個配對測點研磨前為 110、100、90 nm，研磨後為 75、70、65 nm。逐點移除量為 35、30、25 nm，平均 30 nm；表面高度極差由 20 降為 10 nm。請分別畫高度與移除量，不把平均移除量當成平坦度；三點不足以代表整片晶圓。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume three matched sites share one height datum: before polishing 110, 100 and 90 nm; after 75, 70 and 65 nm. Removal is 35, 30 and 25 nm, averaging 30 nm; surface-height range falls from 20 to 10 nm. Plot height and removal separately. Mean removal is not flatness, and three sites do not characterize a wafer.

quiz.question: 關於「移除量與平坦度」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Removal versus planarity, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化
把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦
把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料
optionsEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography
Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization
Using one k for every film and slurry
quiz.explanation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 移除量與平坦度：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Removal versus planarity: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「移除量與平坦度」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Removal versus planarity artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
steps.observationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「移除量與平坦度」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Removal versus planarity, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.title: Preston 近似：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range.
steps.instruction: 自訂壓力與相對速度矩陣，以 R=kPV 比較相對速率並註明 k 固定假設。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Choose hypothetical pressure and speed pairs; compare R=kPV with a stated constant-k assumption. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用；摩擦熱可能改變經驗係數。
steps.observationEn: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range; Frictional heating can change the empirical coefficient.
steps.failure: 若採用「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.checkEn: Submit the Preston approximation diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range.

courses.title: CMP 漿料與磨粒控制
courses.summary: 從磨粒族群、化學與機械分工到批次放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Abrasive populations and Chemical and mechanical roles to Lot release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 磨粒族群 → 稀釋代表性
stages.description: 把「磨粒族群」「數目與強度分布」「稀釋代表性」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Abrasive populations, Number versus intensity distributions, Dilution representativeness.

steps.title: 磨粒族群：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Rare large particles can dominate scratching.
steps.instruction:
比較相同平均粒徑但不同大粒尾端的兩個假設分布。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設漿料 A 的離散計數為 9,999 顆直徑 100 nm 加 1 顆 1,000 nm，B 為 10,000 顆直徑 100.09 nm。兩者數目加權平均均為 100.09 nm；大於 500 nm 的顆數卻為 A=1、B=0。畫出尾端計數，說明平均值相同仍可能有不同大粒子風險；這不是實際漿料規格，亦不能單由粒徑斷定刮傷。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare hypothetical distributions with equal means but different large-particle tails. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume slurry A contains 9,999 particles of diameter 100 nm and one of 1,000 nm; B contains 10,000 particles of 100.09 nm. Both number-weighted means are 100.09 nm, but counts above 500 nm are A=1 and B=0. Plot tail counts and explain how equal means conceal large-particle differences. These are not slurry specifications, and diameter alone does not establish scratching.
steps.observation: 稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷；尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。
steps.observationEn: Rare large particles can dominate scratching; Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume.
steps.failure: 若採用「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「磨粒族群」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷。
算例驗收：列出平均值計算及 500 nm 門檻計數；不得把數目加權平均和體積加權平均混用。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Abrasive populations diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Rare large particles can dominate scratching.
Worked-example acceptance: Show both mean calculations and the 500 nm threshold counts; do not interchange number- and volume-weighted means.

courses.title: 互連電遷移可靠度
courses.summary: 從電子流與原子遷移、加速模型到使用情境：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Electron flow and atomic transport and Acceleration model to Use-condition transfer: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 電流密度：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同電流不代表相同電流密度」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal current does not imply equal current density.
steps.instruction:
對兩種截面計算 J=I/A，並分別記錄總電流與截面。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設矩形互連寬 100 nm、厚 50 nm，電流 1 mA，均勻截面 A=5×10⁻¹⁵ m²；J=I/A=2×10¹¹ A/m²=2×10⁷ A/cm²，即 20 MA/cm²。再把厚度改為 40 nm，J 升為 25 MA/cm²。此例只練習單位與幾何敏感度，不是允許電流或可靠度門檻，也忽略局部電流擁擠。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate J=I/A for two cross-sections while recording current and area separately. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a rectangular line 100 nm wide and 50 nm thick carrying 1 mA uniformly. A=5×10⁻¹⁵ m²; J=I/A=2×10¹¹ A/m²=2×10⁷ A/cm², or 20 MA/cm². At 40 nm thickness J becomes 25 MA/cm². This exercises units and geometry sensitivity, not permitted current or a reliability limit; it ignores local current crowding.
steps.observation: 相同電流不代表相同電流密度；膜厚誤差直接傳到電流密度。
steps.observationEn: Equal current does not imply equal current density; Thickness error propagates into current density.
steps.failure: 若採用「用額定電流直接比較不同線寬壽命」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing different widths by rated current alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電流密度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同電流不代表相同電流密度。
算例驗收：驗算 20 與 25 MA/cm²，註明 A/m² 轉 A/cm² 要除以 10,000。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Current density diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal current does not imply equal current density.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 20 and 25 MA/cm², noting that A/m² converts to A/cm² by division by 10,000.

Introduce this diagnostic principle: Atomic blocking boundaries alter back stress. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

courses.title: 時間相依介電崩潰量測
courses.summary: 從電場與厚度、時間解析度到可靠度報告：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Field and thickness and Time resolution to Reliability report: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 電場與厚度 → 初始漏電
stages.titleEn: Field and thickness to Initial leakage
stages.description: 把「電場與厚度」「應力模式」「初始漏電」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Field and thickness, Stress modes, Initial leakage.

steps.title: 電場與厚度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Field and thickness: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ.
steps.instruction:
用假設 V、t 算 E=V/t 並標註均勻平板近似。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設單一均勻介質厚 5 nm、實際介質壓降 1 V，E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm；厚度若為 4 nm 而電壓不變，場增為 2.5 MV/cm。用圖標明壓降與厚度。這不是 TDDB 壽命預測；多層介質、固定電荷與局部場增強未納入。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate E=V/t from hypothetical values and state the uniform planar approximation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a uniform 5 nm dielectric with an actual 1 V drop: E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm. At 4 nm and the same voltage the field becomes 2.5 MV/cm. Label voltage drop and thickness on a sketch. This is not a TDDB lifetime prediction; multilayers, fixed charge and local field enhancement are excluded.
steps.observation: 端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同；多層介質分壓依介電常數而變。
steps.observationEn: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ; Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」。
假設數值與推算：假設單一均勻介質厚 5 nm、實際介質壓降 1 V，E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm；厚度若為 4 nm 而電壓不變，場增為 2.5 MV/cm。用圖標明壓降與厚度。這不是 TDDB 壽命預測；多層介質、固定電荷與局部場增強未納入。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a uniform 5 nm dielectric with an actual 1 V drop: E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm. At 4 nm and the same voltage the field becomes 2.5 MV/cm. Label voltage drop and thickness on a sketch. This is not a TDDB lifetime prediction; multilayers, fixed charge and local field enhancement are excluded.

options: 所有早期失效都視為材料本徵壽命
只報最長未失效時間作為保證
幾何及污染會混合內在與外在失效
optionsEn: Calling all early failures intrinsic material lifetime
Reporting only the longest survivor as a guarantee
Geometry and contamination mix intrinsic and extrinsic failures
quiz.explanation: 幾何及污染會混合內在與外在失效；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometry and contamination mix intrinsic and extrinsic failures. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 缺陷與製程：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Defects and processing: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「所有早期失效都視為材料本徵壽命」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Calling all early failures intrinsic material lifetime.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「缺陷與製程」成果，先指出錯誤主張「所有早期失效都視為材料本徵壽命」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：早失效尾端可能是不同族群。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Defects and processing artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Calling all early failures intrinsic material lifetime". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Early-failure tails may form a separate population. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 幾何及污染會混合內在與外在失效；早失效尾端可能是不同族群。
steps.observationEn: Geometry and contamination mix intrinsic and extrinsic failures; Early-failure tails may form a separate population.
steps.failure: 若採用「所有早期失效都視為材料本徵壽命」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Calling all early failures intrinsic material lifetime", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「缺陷與製程」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「早失效尾端可能是不同族群」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Defects and processing, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Early-failure tails may form a separate population" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「單一最佳估計不足以表達壽命可信度」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: One best estimate does not express lifetime confidence.

steps.instructionEn: Combine sample count, censoring, criterion, model and uncertainty in a review sheet. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 單一最佳估計不足以表達壽命可信度；信賴區間應說明樣本與假設。
steps.observationEn: One best estimate does not express lifetime confidence; Confidence intervals need sample and assumption context.
steps.failure: 若採用「只報最長未失效時間作為保證」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Reporting only the longest survivor as a guarantee", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「可靠度報告」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：單一最佳估計不足以表達壽命可信度。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Reliability report diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: One best estimate does not express lifetime confidence.

courses.title: 動態隨機存取記憶體電容製作
courses.summary: 從1T1C 儲存、側壁共形性到電容整合審查：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From One-transistor one-capacitor storage and Sidewall conformality to Capacitor integration review: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 電容預算：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「薄介電層的電容收益必須和漏電一起評估」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Capacitance gains from thinning require leakage assessment.
steps.instruction:
用 C=εA/t 比較面積、介電常數與厚度三種假設改善。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想平板電容 εr=20、A=1 µm²、t=10 nm，取 ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m，C=ε0εrA/t=17.708 fF。厚度不變而面積加倍時為 35.416 fF。這是幾何練習；未含邊緣場、死層、漏電與位元線負載，不是量產 DRAM 單元規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Use C=εA/t to compare hypothetical area, permittivity and thickness changes. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal parallel-plate capacitor with εr=20, A=1 µm² and t=10 nm. Using ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m gives C=ε0εrA/t=17.708 fF; doubling area at fixed thickness gives 35.416 fF. This geometry exercise excludes fringing, dead layers, leakage and bitline loading and is not a production DRAM-cell specification.
steps.observation: 薄介電層的電容收益必須和漏電一起評估；邊緣場使平板公式成為近似。
steps.observationEn: Capacitance gains from thinning require leakage assessment; Fringing makes the parallel-plate formula approximate.
steps.failure: 若採用「只把介電層無限變薄當成可行最佳解」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating unlimited dielectric thinning as feasible optimization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電容預算」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：薄介電層的電容收益必須和漏電一起評估。
算例驗收：將 µm² 換算為 10⁻¹² m²，驗算 17.708 fF，另列一項公式未包含的影響。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Capacitance budget diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Capacitance gains from thinning require leakage assessment.
Worked-example acceptance: Convert µm² to 10⁻¹² m², verify 17.708 fF and list one excluded effect.

假設數值與推算：假設理想平板電容 εr=20、A=1 µm²、t=10 nm，取 ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m，C=ε0εrA/t=17.708 fF。厚度不變而面積加倍時為 35.416 fF。這是幾何練習；未含邊緣場、死層、漏電與位元線負載，不是量產 DRAM 單元規格。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating unlimited dielectric thinning as feasible optimization.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume an ideal parallel-plate capacitor with εr=20, A=1 µm² and t=10 nm. Using ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m gives C=ε0εrA/t=17.708 fF; doubling area at fixed thickness gives 35.416 fF. This geometry exercise excludes fringing, dead layers, leakage and bitline loading and is not a production DRAM-cell specification.

courses.title: 垂直 NAND 記憶體堆疊
courses.summary: 從垂直字串、階梯接點到良率地圖：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Vertical strings and Staircase contacts to Yield map: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 垂直字串 → 晶圓彎曲
stages.description: 把「垂直字串」「交替薄膜」「晶圓彎曲」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Vertical strings, Alternating films, Wafer bow.

steps.title: 垂直字串：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.
steps.instruction:
畫穿過多層字線的通道並標示選擇閘和每層記憶單元。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設一條 NAND 串有 64 個可儲存單元，每單元用 TLC 編碼 3 bit，原始容量為 64×3=192 bit。另有兩個選擇閘，不能計入儲存單元數；若編碼改為每單元 2 bit，則為 128 bit。未扣 ECC、備援與壞單元，也不由此推算整顆晶片密度。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw a channel through stacked wordlines with select gates and per-layer cells. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume one NAND string has 64 storage cells, each encoded as TLC with 3 bits: raw capacity is 64×3=192 bits. Two additional select gates are not storage cells. At 2 bits per cell the string has 128 raw bits. ECC, redundancy and bad cells are not deducted, and this does not determine whole-chip density.
steps.observation: 堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數；選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。
steps.observationEn: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell; Select gates differ from storage cells.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating stack layers with bits per cell", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「垂直字串」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數。
算例驗收：圖上分開 64 個儲存單元與兩個選擇閘，驗算 192 與 128 bit，說明層數與每單元位元數不同。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Vertical strings diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.
Worked-example acceptance: Separate 64 storage cells from two select gates; verify 192 and 128 bits and distinguish layer count from bits per cell.

假設數值與推算：假設一條 NAND 串有 64 個可儲存單元，每單元用 TLC 編碼 3 bit，原始容量為 64×3=192 bit。另有兩個選擇閘，不能計入儲存單元數；若編碼改為每單元 2 bit，則為 128 bit。未扣 ECC、備援與壞單元，也不由此推算整顆晶片密度。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating stack layers with bits per cell.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume one NAND string has 64 storage cells, each encoded as TLC with 3 bits: raw capacity is 64×3=192 bits. Two additional select gates are not storage cells. At 2 bits per cell the string has 128 raw bits. ECC, redundancy and bad cells are not deducted, and this does not determine whole-chip density.

courses.title: 電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程
courses.summary: 從電荷儲存層、能階深度到記憶窗驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Charge-storage layer and Trap depth to Memory-window acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設兩層介質的面積電容相等、串聯且沒有固定或捕獲電荷，總壓降 4 V 時各分得 2 V。若其中穿隧層厚 5 nm，其平均場為 2 V/5 nm=4 MV/cm。加入捕獲電荷後原分壓模型需重算；這不是寫入電壓建議，也未計算穿隧率。
steps.instructionEn:
Use a series-capacitor diagram to divide voltage across layers with area and permittivity. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume two dielectric layers have equal areal capacitance in series with no fixed or trapped charge. A total 4 V divides into 2 V per layer. If the tunnel layer is 5 nm thick, its average field is 2 V/5 nm=4 MV/cm. Trapped charge requires recalculating voltage division. This is not a programming-voltage recommendation and does not calculate tunneling rate.
steps.observation: 外加閘壓不全部降在穿隧層；介面電荷也會改變分壓。

Submit the Gate coupling diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Not all gate voltage falls across the tunnel layer.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 2 V and 4 MV/cm; explain that equal division requires equal capacitance, not merely equal thickness.

steps.title: 記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證

Introduce this diagnostic principle: Error correction does not replace device measurements. courses.title: 相變化記憶體製作
courses.summary: 從相態與電阻、脈衝能量到陣列耐久度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Phase and resistance and Pulse energy to Array endurance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Heating efficiency relates to active phase-change volume.
steps.instruction: 比較小接觸與大接觸的熱集中位置並標示電流路徑。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Compare heat localization for small/large contacts and mark current paths. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 加熱效率與有效相變體積相關；接觸電阻也影響局部發熱。
steps.observationEn: Heating efficiency relates to active phase-change volume; Contact resistance changes local heating.
steps.failure: 若採用「只以整顆元件體積計算切換能量」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Estimating switching energy from total device volume alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「加熱器幾何」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：加熱效率與有效相變體積相關。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Heater geometry diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Heating efficiency relates to active phase-change volume.

steps.instruction: 接續前一步「加熱器幾何」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只以整顆元件體積計算切換能量」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：接觸電阻也影響局部發熱。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Heater geometry artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Estimating switching energy from total device volume alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Contact resistance changes local heating. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 加熱效率與有效相變體積相關；接觸電阻也影響局部發熱。

steps.title: 脈衝能量：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同能量不同時間形狀可形成不同溫度軌跡」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal energies with different shapes can yield different thermal histories.
steps.instruction:
對假設 V(t)、I(t) 做能量積分，分辨峰值功率與總能量。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設在 PCM 元件端量到理想矩形脈衝，V=2 V、I=0.5 mA、持續 20 ns，電能 E=VIt=20 pJ。保持 V、I 不變而時間加倍，電能為 40 pJ。這不等於材料吸收熱量，亦不能證明 RESET；熱損失、脈衝邊緣及動態電阻另需量測。
steps.instructionEn:
Integrate hypothetical V(t)I(t) and distinguish peak power from total energy. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal rectangular pulse measured at a PCM device: V=2 V, I=0.5 mA for 20 ns. Electrical energy E=VIt=20 pJ; doubling duration at fixed V and I gives 40 pJ. This is not absorbed material heat and does not prove RESET; thermal loss, pulse edges and dynamic resistance need separate evidence.
steps.observation: 相同能量不同時間形狀可形成不同溫度軌跡；波形線纜損失會改變晶片實際脈衝。
steps.observationEn: Equal energies with different shapes can yield different thermal histories; Cable loss changes the actual die pulse.
steps.failure: 若採用「相同焦耳數就必有相同材料狀態」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating joules with identical material states", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「脈衝能量」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同能量不同時間形狀可形成不同溫度軌跡。
算例驗收：以瓦特與秒核對 20 pJ，區分電能、溫度與相態三個不同量。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Pulse energy diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal energies with different shapes can yield different thermal histories.
Worked-example acceptance: Check 20 pJ using watts and seconds and distinguish electrical energy, temperature and phase.

courses.title: 磁阻式記憶體磁穿隧接面
courses.summary: 從MTJ 分層、STT 路徑到記憶體用途：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From MTJ stack and STT pathway to Memory application: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: MTJ 分層 → 磁各向異性
stages.description: 把「MTJ 分層」「TMR 定義」「磁各向異性」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for MTJ stack, TMR definition, Magnetic anisotropy.

steps.title: MTJ 分層：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.
steps.instruction: 畫參考層、穿隧障壁及自由層，標出讀寫端點。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw reference layer, barrier and free layer with read/write terminals. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
steps.observationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
steps.failure: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「MTJ 分層」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit the MTJ stack diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer.

quiz.question: 關於「MTJ 分層」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For MTJ stack, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態
只標自由層方向而不定義參考層
不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比
optionsEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization
Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer
Comparing TMR percentages without denominator conventions
quiz.explanation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: MTJ 分層：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「MTJ 分層」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding MTJ stack artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Reference-layer stability also conditions readout. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
steps.observationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
steps.failure: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「MTJ 分層」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「參考層穩定性也是讀值條件」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for MTJ stack, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Reference-layer stability also conditions readout" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」與「穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer" is not equivalent to "Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: TMR 定義：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「電阻比的分母必須一致」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
steps.instruction:
以假設 RP、RAP 計算 (RAP-RP)/RP 並註明慣例。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一偏壓與溫度下 MTJ 平行電阻 RP=5 kΩ、反平行 RAP=10 kΩ，TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%。若錯用 RAP 當分母會得到 50%。本例不含讀取電路雜訊或電阻分布，不能由平均 TMR 直接宣告可靠讀取。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute (RAP-RP)/RP from hypothetical values with the convention stated. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume MTJ resistances measured at the same bias and temperature are RP=5 kΩ and RAP=10 kΩ. TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%; incorrectly using RAP as denominator gives 50%. Noise and resistance distributions are absent, so mean TMR does not establish reliable reading.
steps.observation: 電阻比的分母必須一致；RA 需註明有效接面面積。
steps.observationEn: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent; Resistance-area values need effective junction area.
steps.failure: 若採用「不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing TMR percentages without denominator conventions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「TMR 定義」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：電阻比的分母必須一致。
算例驗收：驗算 100%，標示分母 RP，並畫出兩態分布可能重疊的情況。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the TMR definition diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 100%, label RP as denominator and sketch a possible overlap of the two state distributions.

steps.title: 熱穩定因子：建立模型

steps.instruction: 用假設 Δ=Eb/(kBT) 比較體積及溫度改變。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

courses.title: 電阻式記憶體製作
courses.summary: 從阻變截面、SET 與 RESET到權重漂移：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Resistive-switching section and SET and RESET to Weight drift: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 形成步驟：故障判讀與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Electroforming artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming forming and subsequent writes start identically". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Forming failures belong in yield statistics. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming forming and subsequent writes start identically", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

steps.title: 交叉陣列：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Array output depends on more than cell conductance.
steps.instruction:
用小型電阻矩陣計算理想列電流，再加入線阻和偷流。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想交叉陣列的一個求和節點具有 G1=10 µS、G2=20 µS，輸入 V1=0.1 V、V2=0.2 V。兩支路電流為 1 與 4 µA，總和 5 µA。請依 I=ΣGV 列式；線阻、非線性、偷漏路徑與 ADC 誤差均未納入，結果不是實際神經網路精度。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute ideal column current for a small conductance matrix, then add line resistance/sneak paths. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal crossbar summing node with G1=10 µS, G2=20 µS and inputs V1=0.1 V, V2=0.2 V. Branch currents are 1 and 4 µA, totaling 5 µA by I=ΣGV. Line resistance, nonlinearity, sneak paths and ADC errors are excluded; the result is not real neural-network accuracy.
steps.observation: 陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定；列電壓因線阻而沿線下降。
steps.observationEn: Array output depends on more than cell conductance; Line resistance changes local column voltages.
steps.failure: 若採用「單元線性就假定整陣列乘法精確」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming linear cells guarantee exact array multiplication", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「交叉陣列」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定。
算例驗收：驗算兩支路與 5 µA 總和，並在電路圖上加一個可能破壞理想求和的寄生元件。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Crossbar array diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Array output depends on more than cell conductance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify the branch currents and 5 µA sum, then add a parasitic element that could break ideal summation.

courses.title: 鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜

courses.summary: 從晶相與鐵電性、摻雜與比例到整合證據：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Phase and ferroelectricity and Dopants and composition to Integration evidence: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 厚度與場：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Thickness and field: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress.
steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設均勻 HZO 薄膜厚 10 nm，真正跨薄膜電壓為 1 V，平均場 E=1 MV/cm；改為 20 nm 則為 0.5 MV/cm。這個換算不能證明鐵電性或矯頑場；介面層分壓、漏電和量測波形需另外檢查。
steps.instructionEn:
Convert hypothetical voltage to field while separating film thickness/interface division. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a uniform 10 nm HZO film with an actual 1 V drop: average E=1 MV/cm; at 20 nm it is 0.5 MV/cm. This conversion does not demonstrate ferroelectricity or a coercive field; interface voltage division, leakage and the measurement waveform require separate checks.
steps.observation: 相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力；局部薄點的電場高於平均。
steps.observationEn: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress; Local thin spots have higher fields.
steps.failure: 若採用「用電壓相同就宣稱不同厚度測試公平」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Claiming fair thickness comparison from equal voltage", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「厚度與場」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力。
算例驗收：驗算兩個場值並指出要驗證可切換極化仍需要哪類對照量測。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thickness and field diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both fields and identify a control measurement still needed to establish switchable polarization.

steps.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET：建立模型
steps.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ.
steps.instruction: 畫獨立電容讀電荷與閘極控制通道讀電流的兩種回路。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw capacitor charge readout and ferroelectric-gated transistor current readout. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同；FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。
steps.observationEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ; FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold.
steps.failure: 若採用「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「FeCAP 與 FeFET」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同。
steps.checkEn: Submit the FeCAP and FeFET diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop.

quiz.question: 關於「FeCAP 與 FeFET」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For FeCAP and FeFET, which inference has a physical basis?
options: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同
同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗
讀出電流小就直接保證不擾動
optionsEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ
Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop
Guaranteeing nondisturbance from small read current

quiz.explanationEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「FeCAP 與 FeFET」成果，先指出錯誤主張「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding FeCAP and FeFET artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop". Introduce this diagnostic principle: FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同；FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。
steps.observationEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ; FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold.
steps.failure: 若採用「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「FeCAP 與 FeFET」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for FeCAP and FeFET, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／物理與模型

knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／驗證與限制

courses.title: CMOS 影像感測器製作
courses.summary: 從像素訊號鏈、完整電荷轉移到感測器驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Pixel signal chain and Complete charge transfer to Sensor acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 像素訊號鏈 → 光二極體深度
stages.titleEn: Pixel signal chain to Photodiode depth
stages.description: 把「像素訊號鏈」「前照與背照」「光二極體深度」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Pixel signal chain, Front versus back illumination, Photodiode depth.

steps.title: 像素訊號鏈：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Pixel signal chain: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies.
steps.instruction: 畫光子、光電荷、轉移閘、浮接擴散與讀出放大器。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

steps.observation: 光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率；轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷。
steps.observationEn: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies; Transfer timing affects readable charge.

steps.title: 飽和與轉換增益：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Saturation and conversion gain: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well.
steps.instruction:
用假設浮接電容算 ΔV=Q/C，比較訊號增益和容量需求。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設 1,000 個電子完整轉移到 10 fF 的感測節點，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C，Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C，電壓變化幅度 ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV。若電容增為 20 fF，幅度為 8.01 mV。忽略寄生、漏失與放大器增益；這不是滿井容量或量子效率。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical floating-node capacitance to compare ΔV=Q/C and capacity. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume 1,000 electrons transfer completely to a 10 fF sense node. With q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C and voltage-change magnitude ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV. At 20 fF it becomes 8.01 mV. Parasitics, charge loss and amplifier gain are excluded; this is neither full-well capacity nor quantum efficiency.
steps.observation: 更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量；讀噪需換算到同一電子或電壓單位。
steps.observationEn: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well; Read noise needs consistent electron or voltage units.
steps.failure: 若採用「用單一增益數值代表動態範圍」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Representing dynamic range by gain alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「飽和與轉換增益」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量。
算例驗收：驗算 16.02 與 8.01 mV，並說明為何電容加倍使電荷轉電壓增益減半。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Saturation and conversion gain diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 16.02 and 8.01 mV and explain why doubling capacitance halves charge-to-voltage gain.

Introduce this diagnostic principle: Separate illumination nonuniformity from sensor nonuniformity. courses.title: 雪崩光二極體製作
courses.summary: 從吸收與倍增、暗電流來源到偵測系統：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Absorption and multiplication and Dark-current sources to Detection system: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:
用同光通量比較低倍增參考與工作偏壓電流並扣暗電流。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設相同光通量下，已扣暗電流的單位增益參考光電流為 10 nA，工作偏壓下為 200 nA，雪崩增益 M=200/10=20。若未扣暗電流便用總電流相除，可能偏差。此例假定參考確為 M=1，且不提供過剩雜訊或擊穿電壓資訊。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare low-gain and operating currents at equal flux with dark subtraction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume equal photon flux and dark-subtracted photocurrents of 10 nA at a unit-gain reference and 200 nA at operating bias. Avalanche gain M=200/10=20. Dividing total currents without dark subtraction can bias gain. The reference is assumed to have M=1; the example does not determine excess noise or breakdown voltage.
steps.observation: 光源漂移會混入增益估計；低偏壓參考仍需確認收集效率。
steps.observationEn: Source drift contaminates gain estimates; Low-bias references still need collection checks.
steps.failure: 若採用「不同光強下的電流比直接當 M」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算 M=20，寫出兩個必要條件：等光通量與暗電流扣除，另註明單位增益參考假設。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Gain calibration diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Source drift contaminates gain estimates.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify M=20 and record equal flux, dark subtraction and the assumed unit-gain reference.

courses.title: 單光子雪崩二極體陣列
courses.summary: 從Geiger 觸發、後脈衝到熱點像素：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Geiger triggering and Afterpulsing to Hot pixels: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: Geiger 觸發 → 偵測機率
stages.description: 把「Geiger 觸發」「淬熄復位」「偵測機率」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Geiger triggering, Quench and reset, Photon-detection probability.

steps.title: Geiger 觸發：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「單像素飽和脈衝不直接量出同時光子數」。

steps.instruction: 畫超額偏壓與雪崩觸發後的脈衝，分離光子數和脈衝幅度。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw excess bias and triggered pulses and separate photon count from pulse height. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 單像素飽和脈衝不直接量出同時光子數；多像素數可擴展陣列動態範圍。
steps.observationEn: A saturated pixel pulse does not directly count simultaneous photons; More microcells can extend array dynamic range.
steps.failure: 若採用「用單一雪崩脈衝高度精確判斷入射光子數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring exact photon number from one avalanche height", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「Geiger 觸發」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：單像素飽和脈衝不直接量出同時光子數。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Geiger triggering diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A saturated pixel pulse does not directly count simultaneous photons.

steps.title: 直接飛行時間：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Direct time of flight: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「往返飛行時間須除以二」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two.
steps.instruction:
用 d=cΔt/2 算假設距離並扣除電子延遲。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設直接 ToF 系統已扣除電子延遲，測得往返時間 10 ns，取 c=3×10⁸ m/s，距離 d=ct/2=1.5 m。若時間誤差為 1 ns，對應距離誤差幅度 0.15 m。未處理多重路徑、光子統計及介質折射率；不可省略往返的二分之一。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute hypothetical d=cΔt/2 after subtracting electronic delay. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a direct-ToF system has removed electronic delay and measures a 10 ns round trip. With c=3×10⁸ m/s, d=ct/2=1.5 m. A 1 ns timing-error magnitude corresponds to 0.15 m. Multipath, photon statistics and medium refractive index are excluded; the round-trip factor of one-half is essential.
steps.observation: 往返飛行時間須除以二；多重反射會產生多個距離峰。
steps.observationEn: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two; Multipath produces multiple range peaks.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用 cΔt 作為單程距離」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

提交「直接飛行時間」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：往返飛行時間須除以二。
算例驗收：驗算 1.5 m 與 0.15 m，畫出發射及返回兩段光路。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Direct time of flight diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1.5 m and 0.15 m and draw the outgoing and returning optical paths.

courses.title: 碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制
courses.summary: 從多型與基板、穿通差排到磊晶放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Polytype and substrate and Threading dislocations to Epitaxy release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 厚度均勻度：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer.
steps.instruction:
建立徑向厚度圖並分開片內與片間偏差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設三個外延厚度測點為 99、100、101 µm，平均 100 µm、極差 2 µm。若僅描述這三點、使用母體定義，標準差 sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm，變異係數 0.8165%；若作樣本估計則標準差為 1 µm。必須寫明分母，且三點不能推論整片缺陷密度。
steps.instructionEn:
Map radial thickness and separate within-wafer from wafer-to-wafer variation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume three epitaxial thickness readings of 99, 100 and 101 µm. Mean is 100 µm and range 2 µm. Describing just these points with the population definition gives standard deviation sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm and CV=0.8165%; the sample estimate instead gives 1 µm. State the denominator; three sites cannot establish wafer-wide defect density.
steps.observation: 一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層；厚度與摻雜分布可能相互相關。
steps.observationEn: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer; Thickness and doping variations may correlate.
steps.failure: 若採用「中心厚度合格就代表全片耐壓一致」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

提交「厚度均勻度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層。
算例驗收：驗算平均、極差及兩種標準差，並在圖上註明取樣位置不足的限制。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thickness uniformity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify mean, range and both standard-deviation definitions and mark the sampling limitation on the map.

knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「每顆缺陷都以同一方式殺死所有晶粒」與「缺陷風險取決於位置與元件敏感度」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Assuming every defect kills every die equally" is not equivalent to "Defect risk depends on location and device sensitivity"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.question: 檢查「晶粒接受區」時，哪個新增因素應納入？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of Die acceptance regions?
options: 元件終端區也可能對缺陷敏感
每顆缺陷都以同一方式殺死所有晶粒
只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格
optionsEn: Device termination can also be defect-sensitive
Assuming every defect kills every die equally
Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements
quiz.explanation: 元件終端區也可能對缺陷敏感；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Device termination can also be defect-sensitive. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 磊晶放行：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Epitaxy release must connect to downstream device needs.
steps.instruction: 整合厚度、摻雜、缺陷、粗糙與基板追溯表。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Combine thickness, doping, defects, roughness and substrate traceability. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求；放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。
steps.observationEn: Epitaxy release must connect to downstream device needs; Release specifications need fixed defect definitions.
steps.failure: 若採用「只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「磊晶放行」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Epitaxy release diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Epitaxy release must connect to downstream device needs.

steps.title: 磊晶放行：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「磊晶放行」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Epitaxy release artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Release specifications need fixed defect definitions. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求；放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。

steps.check: 交出「磊晶放行」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Epitaxy release, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Release specifications need fixed defect definitions" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

courses.title: 碳化矽 MOSFET 製程
courses.summary: 從垂直元件路徑、植入與活化到晶片到模組：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Vertical device path and Implantation and activation to Die-to-module validation: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Vertical device path, Blocking design, Channel interface.

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成」。

steps.instruction: 畫源極、通道、漂移層與背面汲極，追蹤導通。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw source, channel, drift region and backside drain and trace conduction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成；封裝引線也貢獻量到的電阻。
steps.observationEn: Vertical MOSFET resistance has multiple regional contributions; Package leads contribute measured resistance.
steps.failure: 若採用「把全部導通電阻都歸給通道」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing all on-resistance to the channel", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「垂直元件路徑」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成。

steps.observationEn: Low resistance and high blocking require tradeoffs; Termination may limit ideal drift-layer capability.

steps.title: 動態損耗：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「低 RDS(on) 不保證最低總損耗」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss.
steps.instruction:
以假設 V(t)I(t) 積分比較切換損耗與導通損耗。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設功率開關在特定溫度的 RDS(on)=10 mΩ，導通電流 10 A、占空比先設為 100%，導通損耗 I²R=1 W。若熱態電阻加倍，損耗為 2 W。這不含切換、閘極驅動或反向恢復損耗；若占空比為 50% 且電流維持矩形 10 A，平均導通損耗才各減半。另假設每周期切換能量 Eon+Eoff=10 µJ、頻率 100 kHz，切換功率為 1 W，冷態 50% 導通加切換合計 1.5 W，仍未含驅動損耗。
steps.instructionEn:
Integrate hypothetical V(t)I(t) and compare switching/conduction losses. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a power switch has RDS(on)=10 mΩ at a specified temperature and conducts 10 A continuously: I²R=1 W. Doubling hot-state resistance gives 2 W. Switching, gate-drive and reverse-recovery losses are excluded. At 50% duty with rectangular 10 A current, average conduction loss halves in each case. Also assume switching energy Eon+Eoff=10 µJ per cycle at 100 kHz: switching power is 1 W, so the cold 50%-duty conduction-plus-switching total is 1.5 W, still excluding drive losses.
steps.observation: 低 RDS(on) 不保證最低總損耗；電壓電流探棒時間偏移會誤算能量。
steps.observationEn: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss; Probe timing mismatch biases switching energy.
steps.failure: 若採用「只按室溫導通電阻選最高頻方案」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算連續導通 1 W、熱態 2 W、50% 占空比下 0.5/1 W 及冷態含切換的 1.5 W，勿用平均電流直接平方取代 RMS。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Dynamic losses diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1 W continuous, 2 W hot, 0.5/1 W at 50% duty and the cold 1.5 W total including switching; do not square average current instead of using RMS current.

courses.summary: 從異質接面、緩衝層到整合驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Heterojunction and Buffer layer to Integration verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 異質接面 → 常開與常關
stages.description: 把「異質接面」「極化電荷」「常開與常關」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Heterojunction, Polarization charge, Normally on/off.

steps.title: 異質接面：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.
steps.instruction: 畫 AlGaN/GaN 與能帶井，定位二維電子氣。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw AlGaN/GaN and its band well and locate the 2DEG. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
steps.observationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「異質接面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Heterojunction diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping.

quiz.question: 關於「異質接面」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Heterojunction, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層
把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜
將固定極化電荷當成直接流動電流
optionsEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer
Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping
Treating fixed polarization charge as current-carrying particles
quiz.explanation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 異質接面：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「異質接面」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：界面粗糙會影響通道散射。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Heterojunction artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Interface roughness affects channel scattering. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
steps.observationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「異質接面」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「界面粗糙會影響通道散射」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Heterojunction, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Interface roughness affects channel scattering" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Interface roughness affects channel scattering.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」與「異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping" is not equivalent to "A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.observation: 極化電荷和載流子不是相同族群；極化符號依晶向與應變定義。
steps.observationEn: Polarization charge and mobile carriers are different populations; Polarization signs depend on orientation and strain.
steps.failure: 若採用「將固定極化電荷當成直接流動電流」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.title: p-GaN 與凹槽：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: p-GaN and recessed gates: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「對所有 GaN 共用同一閘極電壓規格」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Using one gate-voltage limit for all GaN types.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「p-GaN 與凹槽」成果，先指出錯誤主張「對所有 GaN 共用同一閘極電壓規格」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：凹槽蝕刻損傷可能增加陷阱。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding p-GaN and recessed gates artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Using one gate-voltage limit for all GaN types". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Recess etch damage can add traps. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 不同常關架構有不同閘極容限；凹槽蝕刻損傷可能增加陷阱。
steps.observationEn: Normally-off architectures have different gate tolerances; Recess etch damage can add traps.
steps.failure: 若採用「對所有 GaN 共用同一閘極電壓規格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Using one gate-voltage limit for all GaN types", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「p-GaN 與凹槽」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「凹槽蝕刻損傷可能增加陷阱」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for p-GaN and recessed gates, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Recess etch damage can add traps" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.
