steps.title: 歐姆接觸：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance.
steps.instruction:
以假設 TLM 資料分離接觸電阻和接觸間通道電阻。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設線性 TLM 回歸 Rtotal(L) 的零距離截距為 0.4 Ω，兩端接觸相同且寄生已扣除，截距=2Rc，所以每個接觸 Rc=0.2 Ω。未給接觸寬度，不能報成 Ω·mm；若 I-V 非線性或兩接觸不同，此抽取就需修改。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate contact and channel resistance with hypothetical TLM data. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a linear TLM fit Rtotal(L) has a zero-spacing intercept of 0.4 Ω, with identical contacts and parasitics removed. The intercept is 2Rc, giving Rc=0.2 Ω per contact. Without width, do not report Ω·mm; nonlinear I-V or unequal contacts invalidates the simple extraction.
steps.observation: 接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能；接觸正規化需註明單位寬度。
steps.observationEn: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance; Contact normalization needs width conventions.
steps.failure: 若採用「只提高通道遷移率就消除所有串聯損失」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Eliminating all series loss by increasing mobility alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「歐姆接觸」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能。
算例驗收：驗算 0.2 Ω，區分總截距、單接觸電阻與寬度歸一化電阻。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Ohmic contacts diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 0.2 Ω and distinguish total intercept, single-contact resistance and width-normalized resistance.

steps.title: 熱路徑：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「高臨界電場不代表容易散熱」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal.
steps.instruction: 畫通道熱點經基板、界面到散熱器的路徑。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Trace channel hotspots through substrate/interfaces to a heat sink. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 高臨界電場不代表容易散熱；熱界面電阻可能主導局部溫升。
steps.observationEn: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal; Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看材料能隙就決定可容許功率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Determining allowable power from bandgap alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「熱路徑」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：高臨界電場不代表容易散熱。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Thermal paths diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal.

knowledge.title: 熱路徑／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只看材料能隙就決定可容許功率」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Determining allowable power from bandgap alone.

quiz.question: 關於「熱路徑」，哪項推論有物理依據？

optionsEn: Determining allowable power from bandgap alone

quiz.explanationEn: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 熱路徑：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只看材料能隙就決定可容許功率」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Determining allowable power from bandgap alone.

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Thermal paths artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Determining allowable power from bandgap alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 高臨界電場不代表容易散熱；熱界面電阻可能主導局部溫升。
steps.observationEn: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal; Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看材料能隙就決定可容許功率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check: 交出「熱路徑」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「熱界面電阻可能主導局部溫升」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Thermal paths, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 熱路徑／物理與模型

knowledge.title: 熱路徑／驗證與限制

courses.title: 氮化鎵發光二極體磊晶
courses.summary: 從直接能隙、組成與波長到磊晶驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Direct bandgap and Composition and wavelength to Epitaxy acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Epitaxy acceptance artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Guaranteeing LED electrical behavior from one PL peak". Introduce this diagnostic principle: EL and PL have different excitation profiles. courses.title: 砷化鎵射頻元件製作
courses.summary: 從HBT 與 pHEMT、閘長與寄生到技術選擇：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From HBT versus pHEMT and Gate length and parasitics to Technology selection: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 通道片電荷：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Channel sheet charge: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「片密度與體密度單位不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Sheet and volume density have different units.
steps.instruction:
分開片密度、遷移率與片電阻，做假設單位換算。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設單一載子通道的面密度 ns=10¹² cm⁻²、遷移率 μ=5,000 cm²/(V·s)，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C。片電阻 Rs=1/(qnsμ)≈1,248.4 Ω/□。此式忽略平行通道及接觸電阻；不能直接當成整顆射頻元件導通電阻。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate sheet density, mobility and resistance with unit checks. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a single-carrier channel with sheet density ns=10¹² cm⁻² and mobility μ=5,000 cm²/(V·s), using q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. Sheet resistance Rs=1/(qnsμ)≈1,248.4 Ω/square. Parallel channels and contact resistance are excluded; this is not whole-device RF on-resistance.
steps.observation: 片密度與體密度單位不同；Hall 量測也需要幾何校正。
steps.observationEn: Sheet and volume density have different units; Hall measurements need geometry corrections.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 cm^-2 直接當成 cm^-3」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating cm^-2 as cm^-3", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「通道片電荷」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：片密度與體密度單位不同。
算例驗收：驗算約 1.25 kΩ/□，保留面密度單位，勿把 cm⁻² 當成 cm⁻³。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Channel sheet charge diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Sheet and volume density have different units.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify approximately 1.25 kΩ/square and keep sheet-density units distinct from volume density.

steps.title: 隔離與漏電：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage.
steps.instruction: 畫元件間半絕緣基板及表面路徑，列出關斷量測。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw substrate/surface isolation paths and specify off-state tests. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
steps.observationEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「隔離與漏電」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Isolation and leakage diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Isolation and leakage / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Isolation and leakage / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label.

quiz.question: 關於「隔離與漏電」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Isolation and leakage, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電
只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試
未校正線纜便把總量測當裸晶
optionsEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage
Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label
Treating uncalibrated cable response as bare-die data
quiz.explanation: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 隔離與漏電：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation and leakage: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「隔離與漏電」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Isolation and leakage artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
steps.observationEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「隔離與漏電」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Isolation and leakage, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／物理與模型

knowledge.text: 診斷機制：隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Isolation and leakage / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」與「半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label" is not equivalent to "A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.observation: S 參數必須附頻率、偏壓和參考阻抗；校正後漂移仍可能產生誤差。
steps.observationEn: S-parameters require frequency, bias and reference impedance; Drift after calibration still introduces error.
steps.failure: 若採用「未校正線纜便把總量測當裸晶」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating uncalibrated cable response as bare-die data", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「S 參數」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：S 參數必須附頻率、偏壓和參考阻抗。
steps.checkEn: Submit the S-parameters diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: S-parameters require frequency, bias and reference impedance.

courses.title: 氧化鎵功率元件研究
courses.summary: 從材料潛力與實現、橫向與垂直到研究成熟度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Material potential versus realization and Lateral versus vertical to Research maturity: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

steps.instructionEn:
Build a hypothetical thermal network separating electrical loss and conduction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a steady lumped thermal model with P=2 W, junction-to-ambient Rθ=20 K/W and ambient 25°C. ΔT=PRθ=40 K gives 65°C junction temperature. At 30 K/W the estimate is 85°C. These are not gallium-oxide product ratings; thermal capacitance, nonuniform hotspots and temperature dependence are excluded.
steps.observation: 低電性損失不保證低接面溫度；熱導率要連同晶向和溫度記錄。

提交「自熱侷限」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：低電性損失不保證低接面溫度。
算例驗收：驗算 65°C 與 85°C，說明 K 的溫升可以加到 °C，但熱阻的路徑必須相同。

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「單顆研究元件不足以證明量產成熟」。

steps.observation: 單顆研究元件不足以證明量產成熟；長期可靠度需加速模型和統計。
steps.observationEn: One research device does not establish manufacturing maturity; Long-term reliability requires models and statistics.
steps.failure: 若採用「宣布新結構就等於市場產品已可靠」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.title: 研究成熟度：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「宣布新結構就等於市場產品已可靠」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Equating a new structure announcement with reliable products.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「研究成熟度」成果，先指出錯誤主張「宣布新結構就等於市場產品已可靠」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：長期可靠度需加速模型和統計。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Research maturity artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating a new structure announcement with reliable products". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Long-term reliability requires models and statistics. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Research maturity, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Long-term reliability requires models and statistics" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

courses.title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸
courses.summary: 從單層與晶粒、轉移殘留到晶圓可製造性：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Monolayer and grains and Transfer residue to Wafer manufacturability: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Monolayer and grains, Growth and transfer, Temporary carrier.

steps.title: 接觸抽取：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias.
steps.instruction:
用假設不同通道長度 TLM 比較接觸截距與片電阻。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設二維材料元件的 TLM 資料符合線性 Rtotal(L)，截距 2 kΩ，且兩接觸相同，則每個接觸為 1 kΩ。若某長度的量測總阻為 5 kΩ，模型歸於通道的部分為 3 kΩ。此分解依賴接觸與通道一致性，不適用於任意非線性注入曲線。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical channel-length TLM to separate intercept and sheet resistance. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a 2D-device TLM dataset follows linear Rtotal(L) with intercept 2 kΩ and identical contacts: each contact is 1 kΩ. If total resistance at one spacing is 5 kΩ, the model assigns 3 kΩ to the channel. This decomposition assumes contact/channel consistency and does not apply to arbitrary nonlinear injection curves.
steps.observation: 長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
steps.observationEn: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.
steps.failure: 若採用「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「接觸抽取」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓。
算例驗收：驗算每接觸 1 kΩ 與通道 3 kΩ；若負截距出現，先檢查模型而非宣稱負接觸電阻。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Contact extraction diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1 kΩ per contact and 3 kΩ channel resistance; investigate a negative intercept instead of claiming negative contact resistance.

courses.title: 微機電慣性感測器製程
courses.summary: 從質量彈簧、深矽輪廓到溫漂校正：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Mass and spring and Deep-silicon profile to Temperature calibration: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.titleEn: Mass and spring to Resonance and damping
stages.description: 把「質量彈簧」「差動梳齒」「共振與阻尼」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Mass and spring, Differential combs, Resonance and damping.

steps.title: 質量彈簧：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Mass and spring: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
steps.instruction:
用假設 m、k 畫 F=ma 與 x=ma/k 靜態關係。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical mass/stiffness to draw F=ma and x=ma/k. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.
steps.observation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
steps.observationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
steps.failure: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「質量彈簧」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。
算例驗收：驗算 9.81 nN 與 9.81 nm，確認 µg 到 kg 的轉換是 10⁻⁹。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Mass and spring diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 9.81 nN and 9.81 nm and confirm the 10⁻⁹ conversion from micrograms to kilograms.

knowledge.title: 質量彈簧／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Mass and spring / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」。
假設數值與推算：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Applying static displacement at every frequency.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.

quiz.question: 關於「質量彈簧」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Mass and spring, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件
把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率
差動架構自動消除全部偏差
optionsEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance
Applying static displacement at every frequency
Assuming differential geometry removes every bias
quiz.explanation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 質量彈簧：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mass and spring: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Applying static displacement at every frequency.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「質量彈簧」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Mass and spring artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Dynamics also include damping and inertia. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
steps.observationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
steps.failure: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「質量彈簧」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Mass and spring, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Dynamics also include damping and inertia" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

courses.title: 微機電壓力感測器製程
courses.summary: 從壓力定義、電容讀出到氣壓與高度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Pressure definition and Capacitive readout to Pressure and altitude: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 電容讀出：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「小間隙提高靈敏度但限制行程」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Small gaps improve sensitivity but limit travel.
steps.instruction:
畫膜片和固定電極，分開位移及邊緣寄生電容。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想空氣平板電容 A=1 mm²、間隙 g=10 µm，C=ε0A/g=0.8854 pF；膜片位移使間隙變 9 µm，C≈0.9838 pF。電容增加約 11.11%，並非正好 10%。例中忽略邊緣場、膜片非均勻變形與靜電拉入，不能由此直接回推壓力。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw moving/fixed electrodes and separate displacement from parasitics. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal air parallel-plate capacitor with A=1 mm² and gap g=10 µm: C=ε0A/g=0.8854 pF. Reducing the gap to 9 µm gives approximately 0.9838 pF, an 11.11% increase rather than exactly 10%. Fringing, nonuniform deflection and electrostatic pull-in are absent; capacitance alone does not give pressure.
steps.observation: 小間隙提高靈敏度但限制行程；拉入不穩定限制電容偏壓。
steps.observationEn: Small gaps improve sensitivity but limit travel; Pull-in instability limits capacitive bias.

算例驗收：驗算兩個電容與 11.11% 變化，註明仍缺少壓力到位移的機械模型。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Capacitive readout diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Small gaps improve sensitivity but limit travel.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both capacitances and the 11.11% change and identify the missing pressure-to-deflection model.

courses.title: 薄膜電晶體顯示背板
courses.summary: 從像素開關、閘介面到面板驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Pixel switching and Gate interface to Panel acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 像素開關：建立模型

steps.instructionEn: Draw TFT, storage capacitor and display load and trace row updating. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

stages.description: 把「IGZO 化學」「閘介面」「氫與鈍化」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for IGZO chemistry, Gate interface, Hydrogen and passivation.

steps.title: IGZO 化學：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything.
steps.instruction: 畫氧相關缺陷和載流子，分開導通與關斷需求。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw oxygen-related defects/carriers and separate on/off needs. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善；氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。
steps.observationEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything; Oxygen variation also changes stability.
steps.failure: 若採用「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「IGZO 化學」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善。
steps.checkEn: Submit the IGZO chemistry diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs.

quiz.question: 關於「IGZO 化學」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For IGZO chemistry, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善
通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好
只測膜厚就證明閘介面品質
optionsEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything
Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs
Proving gate-interface quality from thickness alone
quiz.explanation: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: IGZO 化學：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「IGZO 化學」成果，先指出錯誤主張「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding IGZO chemistry artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Oxygen variation also changes stability. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善；氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。
steps.observationEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything; Oxygen variation also changes stability.
steps.failure: 若採用「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「IGZO 化學」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「氧含量變動也會改變穩定性」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for IGZO chemistry, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Oxygen variation also changes stability" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Oxygen variation also changes stability.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」與「載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs" is not equivalent to "Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.instructionEn: Draw dielectric traps/channel and predict subthreshold/hysteresis effects. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 介面品質影響開關陡峭度與穩定；介面電容需和有效閘電容區分。
steps.observationEn: Interface quality affects switching and stability; Distinguish interface response from effective gate capacitance.
steps.failure: 若採用「只測膜厚就證明閘介面品質」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check: 提交「閘介面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：介面品質影響開關陡峭度與穩定。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Gate interface diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Interface quality affects switching and stability.

steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「全部低電流都歸為遷移率差」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Attributing all low current to poor mobility.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「接觸與通道」成果，先指出錯誤主張「全部低電流都歸為遷移率差」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：接觸影響會扭曲表觀遷移率。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Contacts and channel artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Attributing all low current to poor mobility". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Contact effects distort apparent mobility. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 低通道電阻仍可能被接觸主導；接觸影響會扭曲表觀遷移率。
steps.observationEn: Low channel resistance can remain contact-limited; Contact effects distort apparent mobility.
steps.failure: 若採用「全部低電流都歸為遷移率差」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing all low current to poor mobility", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「接觸與通道」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「接觸影響會扭曲表觀遷移率」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Contacts and channel, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Contact effects distort apparent mobility" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.titleEn: Contacts and channel / Verification and limits

steps.title: 保持與漏電：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Hold and leakage: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「低刷新率會放大保持需求」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Low refresh rates increase hold requirements.
steps.instruction:
用假設電容和漏電估算一幀內的像素電壓下降。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設顯示像素保持電容 1 pF、固定漏電 1 pA、保持時間 16 ms，電壓衰減幅度 ΔV=IΔt/C=0.016 V=16 mV。漏電加倍則為 32 mV。這只是假設定值漏電的儲存節點模型，不是 IGZO 面板規格；光照、偏壓應力與寄生耦合另需驗證。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate pixel voltage loss over a frame from hypothetical capacitance/leakage. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a display-pixel storage capacitance of 1 pF, constant leakage of 1 pA and hold time of 16 ms. Voltage-loss magnitude ΔV=IΔt/C=0.016 V=16 mV; doubling leakage gives 32 mV. This constant-leakage model is not an IGZO-panel specification; illumination, bias stress and parasitic coupling need separate evaluation.
steps.observation: 低刷新率會放大保持需求；儲存電容也占用像素面積。
steps.observationEn: Low refresh rates increase hold requirements; Storage capacitors consume pixel area.
steps.failure: 若採用「刷新變慢便可忽略關斷漏電」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Ignoring off leakage at slower refresh", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「保持與漏電」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：低刷新率會放大保持需求。
算例驗收：驗算 16 mV 並保留 ms 到 s 的轉換；說明若漏電隨時間變化需以積分取代常數乘法。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Hold and leakage diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Low refresh rates increase hold requirements.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 16 mV and the millisecond-to-second conversion; explain that time-varying leakage requires integration.

courses.title: 晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測
courses.summary: 從灰階到邊緣、電子劑量到尺寸報告：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Grayscale to edge and Electron dose to Dimension report: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設校正標準的 100 nm 節距在影像上占 40 pixel，比例為 2.5 nm/pixel；量得線寬 20 pixel，名目 CD=50 nm。若線寬抽取本身的不確定度為 1 pixel，單此項即 2.5 nm，尚未合併校正與邊緣模型誤差；不能把像素尺寸當成完整準確度。
steps.instructionEn:
Calibrate nm/pixel with a hypothetical pitch standard and uncertainty. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a calibrated 100 nm pitch spans 40 pixels, giving 2.5 nm/pixel. A 20-pixel width has nominal CD=50 nm. If width extraction alone has 1-pixel uncertainty, that contribution is 2.5 nm before calibration and edge-model errors are combined. Pixel scale is not complete accuracy.

steps.check:

算例驗收：驗算 2.5 nm/pixel、50 nm 與 2.5 nm 誤差項，寫清 1 pixel 指線寬而不是每一側邊緣。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Pixel calibration diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Magnification does not automatically improve scale accuracy.

knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Sample length limits roughness-frequency coverage.

knowledge.title: 線邊粗糙／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「將單邊粗糙度直接乘二當 LWR」與「左右邊相關性影響線寬粗糙」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Doubling one edge roughness as LWR" is not equivalent to "Edge correlation affects line-width roughness"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: 抽樣位置：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「抽樣位置會影響所見分布」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Sampling locations affect observed distributions.
steps.instruction: 在晶圓圖規劃中心、邊緣和圖形密度抽樣。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Plan center, edge and density-based wafer sampling. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 抽樣位置會影響所見分布；圖形方向也應列為抽樣因子。
steps.observationEn: Sampling locations affect observed distributions; Pattern orientation should be a sampling factor.
steps.failure: 若採用「只測容易找到的圖形代表整片」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Representing a wafer by convenient patterns only", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「抽樣位置」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：抽樣位置會影響所見分布。

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Sampling sites artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Representing a wafer by convenient patterns only". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Pattern orientation should be a sampling factor. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只報一個奈米數而省略量測定義」這項錯誤主張。

steps.instruction: 接續前一步「尺寸報告」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只報一個奈米數而省略量測定義」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：溯源鏈應連到長度標準。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Dimension report artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Reporting one nanometer number without its definition". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Traceability should connect to length standards. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

courses.title: 光學散射量測
courses.summary: 從週期標靶、偏振和角度到製程回授：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Periodic targets and Polarization and angle to Process feedback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 週期標靶 → RCWA 假設
stages.description: 把「週期標靶」「前向與反向」「RCWA 假設」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Periodic targets, Forward and inverse, RCWA assumptions.

steps.title: 週期標靶：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「散射反演需要明確幾何參數化」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization.
steps.instruction:
畫光柵節距、線寬、高度與側壁角的參數圖。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設對稱梯形線條高 100 nm、頂寬 40 nm、底寬 60 nm，每側水平差為 (60−40)/2=10 nm。相對水平面的側壁角 atan(100/10)≈84.29°；相對垂直面的傾斜約 5.71°。這是已知幾何的計算，不能證明光學反演已唯一決定此形貌。
steps.instructionEn:
Parameterize grating pitch, width, height and sidewall angle. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a symmetric trapezoidal line 100 nm high, 40 nm wide at top and 60 nm at bottom. Each side shifts horizontally by 10 nm. Sidewall angle from horizontal is atan(100/10)≈84.29°, or 5.71° from vertical. This computes known geometry; it does not prove a unique optical inverse solution.
steps.observation: 散射反演需要明確幾何參數化；節距可固定但須有獨立依據。
steps.observationEn: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization; Fixing pitch needs independent evidence.
steps.failure: 若採用「不定義形狀便宣稱光譜能直接讀出線寬」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Reading CD directly from spectra without geometry assumptions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「週期標靶」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：散射反演需要明確幾何參數化。
算例驗收：驗算兩種角度並在截面上標明參考方向，避免將 84.29° 與 5.71° 誤認互相矛盾。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Periodic targets diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both angles and mark reference directions so 84.29° and 5.71° are not mistaken for contradictory results.

courses.title: 晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測
courses.summary: 從p/s 偏振、厚度與 n到報告與限制：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From p/s polarization and Thickness-index coupling to Report and limits: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設正入射且 n=1.5、厚度 t=100 nm，單程光學路徑 nt=150 nm、往返 300 nm。另一假設薄膜 n=2、t=75 nm 也有同樣 nt。這說明 n 與 t 可能耦合，但不表示兩者的完整橢圓偏光譜相同；Fresnel 振幅、色散與吸收仍有差異。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw surface/interior paths and phase differences. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume normal incidence with n=1.5 and thickness t=100 nm: one-way optical path nt=150 nm and round trip 300 nm. A different hypothetical film with n=2 and t=75 nm has the same nt. This illustrates n–t coupling, not identical full ellipsometric spectra; Fresnel amplitudes, dispersion and absorption can differ.
steps.observation: 光程同時包含厚度及折射率；界面粗糙會改變有效反射。
steps.observationEn: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index; Rough interfaces modify effective reflection.

算例驗收：驗算兩組 nt，並列出至少一項可以幫助區分 n 與 t 的額外光學觀察。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thin-film interference diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both nt products and name an additional optical observation that could help separate n and t.

steps.instructionEn: Trace backside reflection and compare suppressed/unsuppressed data. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

steps.failure: 若採用「所有多重反射都一定來自目標薄膜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing every extra reflection to the target film", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「背面反射」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：基板背反射可污染前表面模型。

steps.title: 背面反射：故障判讀與驗證

steps.title: 報告與限制：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Report and limits: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「省略模型仍可把厚度當直接量尺讀值」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Presenting model-free thickness as a direct ruler reading.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「報告與限制」成果，先指出錯誤主張「省略模型仍可把厚度當直接量尺讀值」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：參數信賴區間應包含模型限制。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Report and limits artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Presenting model-free thickness as a direct ruler reading". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Confidence reporting should include model limitations. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 厚度結果是條件化的模型推論；參數信賴區間應包含模型限制。
steps.observationEn: Thickness is a model-conditioned inference; Confidence reporting should include model limitations.
steps.failure: 若採用「省略模型仍可把厚度當直接量尺讀值」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Presenting model-free thickness as a direct ruler reading", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「報告與限制」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「參數信賴區間應包含模型限制」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Report and limits, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Confidence reporting should include model limitations" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

courses.title: 晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析
courses.titleEn: Wafer defect classification and yield analysis
courses.summary: 從缺陷單位、混淆矩陣到改善驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Defect units and Confusion matrix to Improvement verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Defect units, Coordinate registration, Detection threshold.

steps.title: 缺陷單位：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects.
steps.instruction: 分開影像缺陷、實體缺陷與失效晶粒三種計數。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Separate image detections, physical defects and failed dies. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷；同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察。
steps.observationEn: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects; One defect may appear on several layers.
steps.failure: 若採用「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「缺陷單位」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Defect units diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects.

steps.title: 良率模型：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「Poisson 良率近似依賴獨立均勻假設」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Poisson yield depends on independent uniform defects.
steps.instruction:
用假設隨機獨立缺陷比較 Y=exp(-AD0) 與聚集情況。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設致命缺陷為空間獨立均勻 Poisson 過程，晶粒面積 A=1 cm²、缺陷密度 D0=0.1 cm⁻²，零缺陷良率 Y=exp(−AD0)=exp(−0.1)≈90.48%。面積加倍時 Y≈81.87%。聚集缺陷、冗餘修復與參數失效不在模型內，不能當實廠良率預測。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare hypothetical Poisson yield with clustered defects. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume spatially independent uniform Poisson killer defects with die area A=1 cm² and density D0=0.1 cm⁻². Zero-defect yield Y=exp(−AD0)=exp(−0.1)≈90.48%; doubling area gives 81.87%. Clustering, repair redundancy and parametric failures are excluded; this is not a fab-yield prediction.
steps.observation: Poisson 良率近似依賴獨立均勻假設；聚集模型可能較符合某些缺陷族群。
steps.observationEn: Poisson yield depends on independent uniform defects; Cluster models can suit some defect populations.
steps.failure: 若採用「任意聚集分布都用同一密度精確預測」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

提交「良率模型」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：Poisson 良率近似依賴獨立均勻假設。
算例驗收：驗算兩個良率，確認 AD0 無單位，並說明良率並非隨面積線性下降。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Yield model diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Poisson yield depends on independent uniform defects.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both yields, confirm dimensionless AD0 and explain why yield does not decrease linearly with area.

courses.title: 製程統計管制系統
courses.summary: 從規格與控制、Xbar 與 R到變更管理：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Specifications and control and Xbar and range to Change management: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設穩定且近似常態的製程，規格 LSL=95、USL=105，平均 μ=101、組內標準差 σ=1（使用同一單位）。Cp=(105−95)/(6σ)=1.667；Cpk=min((105−101)/(3σ),(101−95)/(3σ))=1.333。此組假設尚未由資料驗證，控制界限也不等於 95/105 規格界限。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute hypothetical Cp/Cpk after checking stability and distribution. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a stable approximately normal process with LSL=95, USL=105, mean μ=101 and within-process σ=1 in common units. Cp=10/(6σ)=1.667; Cpk=min(4/(3σ),6/(3σ))=1.333. These assumptions still need data support; control limits are not the 95/105 specification limits.
steps.observation: 能力指標需要適用假設與穩定條件；非正態資料需要合適分布處理。
steps.observationEn: Capability requires suitable assumptions and stability; Nonnormal data need suitable distribution handling.

算例驗收：驗算 Cp 與 Cpk，指出偏離規格中心使 Cpk 低於 Cp，並保留穩定性驗證步驟。

Worked-example acceptance: Verify Cp and Cpk, explain the reduction from off-centering and retain a process-stability check.

courses.title: 先進製程控制與虛擬量測
courses.titleEn: Advanced process control and virtual metrology
courses.summary: 從閉迴路邊界、時間切割到版本回復：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Closed-loop boundary and Temporal splitting to Version rollback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: Run-to-run 控制：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign.
steps.instruction:
用假設線性增益將上一片誤差換成下一片小幅修正。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設無延遲、無雜訊的教學模型 y=2u+1，現在 u=4 得 y=9，目標 y*=11。以模型反算 Δu=(11−9)/2=1，故下次 u=5、預測 y=11。若真實斜率不是 2 或量測有延遲，這次修正可能過度；這是紙上控制練習，不能作機台指令。
steps.instructionEn:
Convert prior-wafer error to a bounded next-run correction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a delay-free noise-free teaching model y=2u+1. Current u=4 gives y=9; target y*=11. Model inversion gives Δu=(11−9)/2=1, so next u=5 predicts y=11. A different real slope or delayed measurement can cause overcorrection. This is a paper control exercise, not a machine command.
steps.observation: 控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向；增益估計錯誤可放大振盪。
steps.observationEn: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign; Gain-estimation errors can amplify oscillation.
steps.failure: 若採用「不知增益正負就直接反覆加大修正」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check:
提交「Run-to-run 控制」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向。
算例驗收：驗算 u=5，並以斜率改為 3 的另一假設檢查模型失配為何改變控制增益。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Run-to-run control diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify u=5 and use an alternative slope of 3 to explain why model mismatch changes the required control gain.

courses.title: 晶圓級參數測試
courses.summary: 從SMU 四象限、量測等待到判限與重測：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From SMU quadrants and Settling time to Limits and retest: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設 DUT=100 Ω、兩條 force 引線各 2 Ω，輸入 1 mA。二線總壓降為 104 mV，反算 104 Ω；理想四線 Kelvin 的 sense 電流可忽略，僅量 DUT 100 mV，得 100 Ω。接點位於哪裡仍決定是否包含接觸電阻，四線並不自動消除所有誤差。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate force/sense and state the low-sense-current assumption. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a 100 Ω DUT, two 2 Ω force leads and 1 mA. A two-wire measurement reads 104 mV and infers 104 Ω; ideal four-wire Kelvin sensing with negligible sense current reads 100 mV across the DUT, giving 100 Ω. Sense-contact placement determines whether contact resistance is included; four-wire does not remove every error.
steps.observation: Kelvin 可降低引線壓降但不能取消所有誤差；Sense 接觸開路仍會破壞量測。

Worked-example acceptance: Verify 104 and 100 Ω and draw force/sense contacts and the voltage-measurement boundary.

courses.title: 台積電 GIGAFAB 廠務整合案例
courses.summary: 從工廠與供應鏈、振動與基礎到公開案例審查：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Fab and supply chain and Vibration and foundations to Public-case review: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.description: 把「設備節能」「水循環盤查」「公開案例審查」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Equipment energy saving, Water accounting, Public-case review.

steps.title: 設備節能：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Equipment energy saving: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks.
steps.instruction:
依假設排程比較工作、待機與喚醒能量，加入重新穩定時間。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一設備在 8 小時比較窗口中，維持工作狀態為 10 kW、可用待機狀態為 2 kW。能耗分別 80 與 16 kWh，差 64 kWh；若喚醒與重新穩定另耗 10 kWh，淨差才是 54 kWh。這是自訂能源帳，不是台積電實測資料，也未計產能與良率代價。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare active/idle/wakeup energy with restabilization time. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an 8-hour comparison for one tool: active power 10 kW versus an available standby state at 2 kW. Energy is 80 versus 16 kWh, a 64 kWh difference; if wakeup and restabilization add 10 kWh, net savings are 54 kWh. These invented teaching inputs are not TSMC measurements and exclude throughput and yield costs.
steps.observation: 節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定；喚醒後需驗證可用而非只顯示通電。
steps.observationEn: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks; Wakeup needs readiness, not merely power-on status.
steps.failure: 若採用「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「設備節能」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定。
算例驗收：驗算 64 與 54 kWh，區分 kW 功率和 kWh 能量，並列出喚醒驗收需求。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Equipment energy saving diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 64 and 54 kWh, distinguish kW from kWh and list a wakeup-qualification requirement.

knowledge.title: 設備節能／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Equipment energy saving / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」。
假設數值與推算：假設同一設備在 8 小時比較窗口中，維持工作狀態為 10 kW、可用待機狀態為 2 kW。能耗分別 80 與 16 kWh，差 64 kWh；若喚醒與重新穩定另耗 10 kWh，淨差才是 54 kWh。這是自訂能源帳，不是台積電實測資料，也未計產能與良率代價。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume an 8-hour comparison for one tool: active power 10 kW versus an available standby state at 2 kW. Energy is 80 versus 16 kWh, a 64 kWh difference; if wakeup and restabilization add 10 kWh, net savings are 54 kWh. These invented teaching inputs are not TSMC measurements and exclude throughput and yield costs.

quiz.question: 關於「設備節能」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Equipment energy saving, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定
關機時間越長就一定總成本最低
把循環流量重複算成新增節水量
optionsEn: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks
Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost
Counting circulating flow repeatedly as new savings
quiz.explanation: 節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 設備節能：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment energy saving: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「設備節能」成果，先指出錯誤主張「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：喚醒後需驗證可用而非只顯示通電。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Equipment energy saving artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Wakeup needs readiness, not merely power-on status. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定；喚醒後需驗證可用而非只顯示通電。
steps.observationEn: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks; Wakeup needs readiness, not merely power-on status.
steps.failure: 若採用「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「設備節能」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「喚醒後需驗證可用而非只顯示通電」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Equipment energy saving, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Wakeup needs readiness, not merely power-on status" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

courses.title: imec NanoIC 試驗線架構
courses.summary: 從試驗線目的、系統探索到里程碑核對：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
courses.summaryEn: From Pilot-line purpose and System exploration to Milestone verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
courses.scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 試驗線目的 → 技術模組

steps.title: 試驗線目的：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives.
steps.instruction: 畫研究假說、試片、學習迴圈與量產移轉四個功能。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hypothesis, test vehicle, learning cycle and production-transfer functions. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同；技術成功也需評估可移轉性。
steps.observationEn: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives; Technical success also needs transferability assessment.
steps.failure: 若採用「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「試驗線目的」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Pilot-line purpose diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives.

knowledge.title: 試驗線目的／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives.

knowledge.title: 試驗線目的／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products.

quiz.explanationEn: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 試驗線目的：故障判讀與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Pilot-line purpose artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Technical success also needs transferability assessment. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

steps.title: 分批實驗：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「實驗矩陣有助區分交互作用」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Experimental matrices help separate interactions.
steps.instruction:
建立只改兩項變因的假設分批矩陣，保留對照。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設試驗線比較兩個因子 A、B，各低／高兩水準，全因子需要 2²=4 組條件。每組做 3 個獨立製程重複，共 12 次；對同一試片讀三次不是三個獨立製程重複。若四組平均響應依 A低B低、A高B低、A低B高、A高B高為 10、14、12、20，A 效應在 B低為 4、B高為 8，交互作用的差中之差為 4。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a two-factor hypothetical split with controls. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a pilot-line experiment with two factors A and B at low/high levels. A full factorial needs 2²=4 conditions; three independent process replicates per condition require 12 runs. Three readings of one specimen are not three independent process replicates. If condition means in low-low, high-low, low-high and high-high order are 10, 14, 12 and 20, A effects are 4 at low B and 8 at high B, giving a difference-in-differences interaction contrast of 4.
steps.observation: 實驗矩陣有助區分交互作用；分批設計須記錄交互作用假設。
steps.observationEn: Experimental matrices help separate interactions; Split designs need stated interaction assumptions.
steps.failure: 若採用「同時更改全部模組後仍能單獨歸因」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing causes after changing every module", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「分批實驗」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：實驗矩陣有助區分交互作用。
算例驗收：列出四組矩陣、12 次獨立重複及交互作用對比 4；註明此為未標準化差中之差，不等同所有軟體的效應係數定義。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Split experiments diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Experimental matrices help separate interactions.
Worked-example acceptance: List four conditions, 12 independent runs and interaction contrast 4; note that this unscaled difference-in-differences is not every software package's effect-coefficient definition.

steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric.
steps.instruction: 定義可重複性、晶圓分布、可靠度與移轉文件的驗收。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Define repeatability, wafer distributions, reliability and transfer evidence. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標；樣本數與失敗樣本不能從門檻中消失。
steps.observationEn: Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric; Gates must retain sample counts and failures.
steps.failure: 若採用「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「成熟度門檻」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Maturity gates diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric.

knowledge.title: 成熟度門檻／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric.

knowledge.title: 成熟度門檻／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity.

quiz.question: 關於「成熟度門檻」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Maturity gates, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟
把預定時程當成已完成量測結果
成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標
optionsEn: Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity
Treating a schedule as completed measurement evidence
Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric
quiz.explanation: 成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 成熟度門檻：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「成熟度門檻」成果，先指出錯誤主張「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：樣本數與失敗樣本不能從門檻中消失。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Maturity gates artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Gates must retain sample counts and failures. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標；樣本數與失敗樣本不能從門檻中消失。
steps.observationEn: Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric; Gates must retain sample counts and failures.
steps.failure: 若採用「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「成熟度門檻」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「樣本數與失敗樣本不能從門檻中消失」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Maturity gates, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Gates must retain sample counts and failures" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 成熟度門檻／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：樣本數與失敗樣本不能從門檻中消失。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Gates must retain sample counts and failures.

knowledge.title: 成熟度門檻／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」與「成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity" is not equivalent to "Maturity is a body of evidence, not a record metric"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.explanationEn: Gates must retain sample counts and failures. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 里程碑核對：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「各里程碑代表不同完成程度」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Milestones represent different completion states.

steps.observationEn: Milestones represent different completion states; Tool qualification and product qualification differ.
steps.failure: 若採用「把預定時程當成已完成量測結果」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
